contract.label: Chart
contract.summary: The chart surface — ChartContainer with its config, colours and the chart theme — and the one header composition every chart card follows.
contract.purpose: The chart surface: `ChartContainer` sets the plot's config, colours and the chart theme — grid, axis labels, the neutral reference line — so every Recharts plot in a consuming app reads as one system, and the same tokens theme a Highcharts plot in the portal.
useWhen: A reading over time, a breakdown, a ranking — anything the eye should compare.
A single figure against a ceiling is not a chart: that is `radial-gauge`.
dontUseWhen: The data is a handful of numbers — a stat tile or a table says it faster.
requires: The canonical header: `CardHeader` with the title and its last-updated line; `CardAction` with, in order, the primary action (if any), the two-state overlay `Toggle`, the connected range presets `ToggleGroup` with the compact `date-picker` trigger, and the export `dropdown-menu` icon button — every control at `size="default"`.
Below the header: the axis caption as `text-caption` above the plot, the time-zone line under it, the legend centred, then the threshold strip.
Series coloured from the commodity ramp by meaning; reference lines in the neutral `chart-reference` token, dashed.
forbids: A header that swaps the order of the controls, or mixes `size` across them.
A `fontSize` on a Recharts element — the text inherits the scale from the container.
A second copy of recharts — the chart primitives share a React context with `ChartContainer`.
rules: **The chart header is one composition.** `CardHeader` > `CardTitle` + a last-updated `CardDescription`; `CardAction` > [primary action] [`Toggle`] [connected `ToggleGroup`] [`date-picker` icon] [export icon], all `size="default"`. Then the axis caption (`text-caption`) above the plot, the time-zone line under it, the legend centred, the threshold strip last.

**The chart theme is five tokens**, read by `ChartContainer` for a Recharts plot and by a Highcharts chart in the portal: `chart-grid`, `chart-axis-label`, `chart-reference`, `chart-series-width`, `chart-reference-width`.

A ported plot cites the legacy line and window variables that ship in the stylesheet — `--chart-legacy-line-<colour>`, `--chart-legacy-peak-1..7`, `--chart-legacy-window-high|normal|low` — through the product's series-to-hue mapping, never a literal, and never for a new feature.

behavior.loading: The card keeps its header and shows a `skeleton` the plot's height in the plot's place.
behavior.empty: No series selected or no data in range is an `empty` state in the plot's place, with the header's controls still live.

requirements: `accessibilityLayer` on the Recharts chart; every control in the header labelled.
A series is never told apart by hue alone: the legend names it and the tooltip reads its value.

examples: `<Card><CardHeader><CardTitle>Power demand</CardTitle><CardDescription>Last updated 2:45 PM</CardDescription><CardAction><Button>Set alert</Button><Toggle variant="outline">14-day forecast</Toggle><ToggleGroup variant="outline" layout="connected">…</ToggleGroup><DatePicker compact /><ChartExportMenu /></CardAction></CardHeader><CardContent><ChartContainer config={config}>…</ChartContainer></CardContent></Card>`
antiPatterns: A text "Export" button, or a full-width date field, in the header.
A range preset strip drawn as a spaced frame, taller than the toggle beside it.
A hex grid colour or axis label colour set on the Recharts element instead of the theme tokens.
